subject: maths
question: A sum of ₹x amounts to ₹10,483 after 3 years and to ₹12,727 after 7 years at the same rate percent per annum simple interest. The value of x is :
solution:
**Given:**

Rs. x to Rs. 10,483 after 3 years at SI

Rs. x to Rs. 12,727 after 7 years at SI

For both cases, rate of interest is same.

**Formula used :**

Principal = Amount - Interest

**Calculation:**

SI in four years = Rs (12,727 - 10,483)

⇒ Rs. 2244&n
